chunks: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام passed by me while I was between Makkah and Madinah placing stones, so I said, "Is this from that?" He said, "Yes."

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: a kunyah for Imām Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ: Abū ʿUbaydah, the narrator reporting this incident
key_terms.الْأَحْجَارَ: stones being placed by the narrator
key_terms.الْمَدِينَةِ: Madinah, the other endpoint of the route mentioned
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Makkah, one endpoint of the route mentioned

ai.seo_question: What did Imām al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say when Abū ʿUbaydah asked him about placing stones between Makkah and Madinah?
ai.summary: This hadith briefly records an encounter with Imām Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام during travel between Makkah and Madinah. It indicates his affirmation of Abū ʿUbaydah al-Ḥadhdhāʾ's understanding concerning the act of placing stones, within the chapter related to the virtue and sanctity of mosques.
